spots.text: Everything here is square. Everything here is level. It took some doing.

secrets.name: The Flat Room
secrets.text: In the crease of the fold, facing the way nobody walks, a narrow door, and behind it the only room here with four square walls and a level ceiling. On the table somebody has been trying to flatten a sheet of paper under books. It will not lie flat.

meta.label: The Folded Corridor
meta.blurb: A corridor folded like paper: creases in the ceiling, walls leaning in, doors set on their sides. You turn right at a fold, and then left at a corner, and you are back where you started. You have not turned round. You check.
